title: Hot tubs and spas: NEC Article 680 Part IV and manufacturer guidance
edition: NEC 2017–2023 Article 680 Part IV (secondary summaries); manufacturer installation guides
notes: NFPA 70 is behind a login; the distances are from secondary summaries that differ by edition, so findings are advisory. Outdoor spas follow the pool rules (680.22), whose receptacle distances the sources give as 6, 10 or 20 ft; only the indoor rules (680.43) are encoded. The floor load is a check prompt, not a structural design.

zones.description: About 3 ft (0.9 m) clear round a portable spa so its skirt panels and equipment bay can come off

spa.description: Receptacles at least 6 ft (1.83 m) from the inside wall of an indoor spa, wall switches at least 5 ft (1.52 m), luminaires and fans over it at least 7 ft 6 in (2.29 m) above the water; the filled spa and its bathers checked against the floor's 40 psf (1.92 kPa) residential live load, and a pad of at least 4 in (100 mm) of reinforced concrete on grade
